fusions.name: Strike That Shoves
fusions.desc: A braced strike that deals 15 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds, with a 60% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Will Not Wash Out
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 26 poison damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Rooted Coils
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Dig In and Coil
fusions.desc: When your health falls below a third, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
